title: CHALK PAINT & CUSTOMIZE CABINETS ON A DIME! (fast how-to tutorial!)
description:
Hey, guys!  In today's video I'll show you how to easily paint a bathroom vanity for CHEAP!  I'll walk you through the steps to chalk paint a bathroom cabinet, the best tips and tricks you need to know to get the job done right, and how to customize your vanity to look expensive using hardware store supplies.  If you have an outdated vanity (this one is about 15 years old and had some water damage) this chalk paint and poly finish is the perfect solution.  Enjoy!
